messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: change in drop = FALSE behavior
parts:
Hi all,

It seems to me that drop = FALSE no longer behaves as it once did
inside of facet_wrap(). Here is my test code (also available at
http://gist.github.com/546065 )

# Create a local copy
mpg <- mpg

# Create cyl2 which has 6 levels, 2 unused
mpg$cyl2 <- factor(mpg$cyl, levels = c(2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10))

# load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

# plot with defaults (i.e., drop = TRUE)
qplot(displ, hwy, data = mpg, main = "drop = TRUE") + facet_wrap(~ cyl2)

# plot with drop = FALSE
qplot(displ, hwy, data = mpg, main = "drop = FALSE") + facet_wrap(~
cyl2, drop = FALSE)

# both plots appear to have the same results now
# this was not always the case as can be seen here
# http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/facet_wrap.html

I tested this on:

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.11.1 (2010-05-31)
i486-pc-linux-gnu

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.11.1 (2010-05-31)
i386-pc-mingw32

Both with these versions of ggplot2:

other attached packages:
[1] ggplot2_0.8.8 proto_0.3-8 reshape_0.8.3 plyr_1.1

I apologize that I do not have anything more useful to add. I can
never seem to trace or debug the functions in ggplot past the calls to
FacetWrap$new for instance.

Josh
